title: John 8:42-44 — you are of your father the devil, a liar and murderer from the beginning
summary: John 8:42-44: Jesus tells His hearers that if God were their Father they would love Him, since He came from God and was sent by Him; because they cannot hear His word, they are of their father the devil, a murderer from the beginning and the father of lies. Jesus' words (I, Me, My, truth) are in red; God and Father/He (God the Father) are in blue.

text.text: 42 Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love Me, for I proceeded forth and have come from God, for I have not even come on My own initiative, but He sent Me.
43 “Why do you not understand what I am saying? It is because you cannot hear My word.

44 “You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and does not stand in the truth because there is no truth in him. Whenever he speaks a lie, he speaks from his own nature, for he is a liar and the father of lies.
